description: Update UI components (FormPanel, ResultsPanel), i18n translations, and useHallCalculations hook to support the new Eurocode parameters and display extended results including utilization ratio, governing combination/condition, steel mass per m2, and deflection checks.
steps: 1. Update src/components/FormPanel.tsx: (a) Add missing import for useHallCalculations from '../hooks/useHallCalculations'. (b) Add terrain category select field (options: I, II, III, IV) in LoadsSection. (c) Add snow exposure select field (options: windy/0.8, normal/1.0, sheltered/1.2) in LoadsSection. (d) Update DEFAULT_PARAMS to include terrainCategory: 2 and snowExposure: 'normal'. (e) Add terrainCategory and snowExposure to the params change handlers.
2. Update src/hooks/useHallCalculations.ts: Add params.terrainCategory and params.snowExposure to the useMemo dependency array.

3. Update src/components/ResultsPanel.tsx: (a) Add display of utilization ratio next to profile name (e.g. 'IPE 270, eta = 0.87'). (b) Show governing combination name. (c) Show governing condition (bending/stability/deflection). (d) Show steel mass per m2 of floor area. (e) Show deflection check results (column delta vs limit, rafter delta vs limit). (f) Use color coding: green for eta<0.85, yellow for 0.85-0.95, orange/red for >0.95.

4. Update src/i18n/pl.json: Add translations for new fields: terrainCategory ('Kategoria terenu'), snowExposure ('Ekspozycja sniegowa'), terrain categories (I-IV descriptions), snow exposure options (wietrzna/normalna/zabudowana), utilization ('Wykorzystanie nosnosci'), governingCombination ('Kombinacja decydujaca'), governingCondition ('Warunek decydujacy'), steelMass ('Masa stali'), deflection labels, condition names (bending/stability/deflection in Polish).

5. Update src/i18n/en.json: Add English translations for all new fields: terrainCategory ('Terrain category'), snowExposure ('Snow exposure'), terrain categories (I-IV), exposure options (windy/normal/sheltered), utilization ('Utilization ratio'), governingCombination ('Governing combination'), governingCondition ('Governing condition'), steelMass ('Steel mass'), deflection labels.

6. Fix pre-existing TypeScript errors in src/3d/elements/CrossBracing.tsx (remove unused variables roofAngleRad, midRoofY, midRoofZ_left, midRoofZ_right) and src/3d/elements/Truss.tsx (fix webMemberSize/webMemberThickness props issue).
7. Update src/components/Layout.tsx if needed to pass new params properly.
acceptance_criteria: FormPanel displays terrain category and snow exposure selects
ResultsPanel shows utilization ratio, governing combination, governing condition, steel mass/m2
Both pl.json and en.json have all new translation keys
useHallCalculations hook depends on all new parameters
No TypeScript errors in the project (pnpm build passes)
The full project builds successfully with: npx tsc -b && npx vite build
